title: Yoga Time
author: Mariam Gates
target_audience: Families interested in mindfulness and movement
core_themes: Introducing yoga and mindful movement to children
Joyful and playful engagement with exercise
primary_purpose: To engage young children in the practice of yoga through simple, accessible poses and inviting illustrations, fostering both physical health and emotional self-awareness in a playful way.

structure_format.organization: Sequenced visual and verbal instructions for yoga poses; each pose paired with illustrations and short, guiding sentences
features: Simple text guiding each yoga pose
Encouraging prompts for mindfulness and focus

key_concepts_lessons: Yoga can be fun and approachable for children of all ages.
Physical movement and guided breathing support calmness and focus.
Mindfulness and body awareness are skills children can begin to develop early.
Establishing routines with movement can offer comfort and structure.
notable_features: Step-by-step instructions for basic yoga poses for children
Emphasis on relaxation and emotional well-being as well as physical activity
Welcoming illustrations that depict diverse children participating
Designed for joint participation—children and caregivers/teachers together
cultural_historical_context: Reflects a growing 21st-century focus on mindfulness, wellness, and movement for children as parents and educators seek accessible ways to encourage healthy habits and stress relief from an early age.
reception_impact: Praised by parents, educators, and reviewers as a gentle introduction to yoga for young children
Often used in classrooms and at home to foster calm and focus
Noted for its clarity, inclusiveness, and inviting artwork
comparable_titles: Good Morning Yoga: A Pose-by-Pose Wake Up Story by Mariam Gates
Breathe Like a Bear by Kira Willey
I Am Yoga by Susan Verde
Yoga Bug by Sarah Jane Hinder
